html:
Explore the cultural, historical, and natural highlights of Nha Trang City with Vietlook Travel. This city tour is an ideal choice for travelers who want to discover famous landmarks, learn about local history, and experience the unique culture of this beautiful coastal city in just one day.

TOUR ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Car and professional English-speaking tour guide pick you up at the meeting point.

Depart to visit the most famous attractions in Nha Trang City.

09:30
Visit the Institute of Oceanography, one of the largest marine research centers in Southeast Asia.

Continue to the Mountain Church (Nha Trang Cathedral) and Long Son Pagoda, well-known landmarks representing the religious and cultural life of local people.

12:30
Have lunch at a local restaurant.

13:30
Visit Hon Chong Scenic Area, a beautiful coastal rock formation.

Continue to Po Nagar Cham Towers, built between the late 7th and 12th centuries. This ancient temple complex is a symbol of

Cham culture and the pride of the Cham people.

15:30
Visit Mai Sinh Bird’s Nest Village to learn about the processing of swiftlet nests.

Guests can take photos and shop for authentic bird’s nest products from Khanh Hoa Salanganes Nest Company.

16:30
Return to the hotel. End of the tour.

TOUR PRICE

Price per person (pax): USD 25

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off by car

  • Lunch at a local restaurant

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance tickets

  • Bottled water

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional services outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 meter: Free of charge

  • From 1m to 1.29m: 70% of adult price

  • From 1.29m and above: Adult price applies
